comment: Entry points excluded from the live gate pending (or after) investigation. Fields: path, tag, note. SKIPPED-SWEEP re-verified on the newest engines (2026-07-12): still unsolvable everywhere — r3723 NO, r4088 NO, r4133 NO (all diverge, non-convergent at 1000 iters). ROOT-CAUSED 2026-07-10: the deck data itself is pathological. The 480 V DER microgrid island (m2001der480-2 delta secondary of a 750 kVA xfmr) is operated at the edge of voltage collapse, and Storage.battery1 (charging)/battery2 (idling) tip the snapshot power flow over the fixed-point stability boundary: |V| at M2001-ESS1 grows geometrically (~x2000/iteration) until NaN. Bisected: both batteries disabled -> converges (121 iters); battery1=discharging -> converges (130); charging or idling -> geometric divergence. Engine-lineage-consistent: pinned oracle, official EPRI r3723/r4088/r4133, and the Rust port all diverge identically on the vendored deck; on the healed variant (storages disabled) Rust converges in EXACTLY the oracle's 121 iterations. Deck/scenario bug, nothing to fix port-side.

SKIPPED-SWEEP re-affirmed (2026-07-12): the CF-D PROVEN cross-solver conditioning-floor proof still holds at this tree (decomposition, not a tolerance sweep). cond(assembled Y) = 9.79e11, driven by two linecode-BUSBAR ultra-switch lines in series with the 46 kV source: Line.MDV_SUB_1_HSB (length=0.001 units=m -> ~1e-10 ohm -> Y~1e10 S; the dominant ill-conditioner) and Line.SSswitch (~1e-7 ohm -> Y~1e7 S). The step-0 entry-0 node-V |diff|=5.53e-1 (rel 2.08e-5) at BUSSOURCE/MDV_SUB_1_HSB is solver junk in the ill-conditioned direction. Decomposition: assembled Y BIT-IDENTICAL (570/570 entries max|dY|=0); Vsource injection Yprim*E BIT-IDENTICAL; loads identical to 7 figs; on the equivalent linear system the three solvers spread comparably — faer(Rust) vs KLU(oracle) 0.758 V, faer vs scipy(equilibrated) 0.555 V, KLU vs scipy 0.776 V — residual parity ||Y*V-inj||inf 4.40e-2 (Rust) vs 4.56e-2 (oracle); neither engine is more correct. Regulator lands the identical tap; the 0.55 V gap is IDENTICAL with the regulator disabled (RegControl+SubXfmr exonerated). A ~1 V v_abs band (~4e-5 rel at 46 kV) is too wide to admit without masking real substation-transformer bugs, so it stays documented here (floating_zeroseq_bus precedent). Full proof: tests/TOLERANCE_NOTES.md, STATUS.md CF-D record.
